title: The embed pin counts builder calls per file: exempt them by enclosing function using the TypeScript parser, so a new builder fails the pin
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/embed-writes.test.ts keeps the count rule (BUILDER_CALLS 2/1/1). A hand-rolled brace counter tried on PR 1434 could hang CI and missed a new builder, so it was reverted (adversary on PR 1434, 2026-11-12)
